title: Code Comprehensor: Hierarchical Documentation and Cross-Modal Retrieval for Large Repositories
title_zh: Code Comprehensor：面向大型代码库的分层文档与跨模态检索

paragraphs.en: Understanding large, complex, and rapidly evolving code bases remains a core challenge for software engineering at scale, hindering onboarding, maintenance, refactoring, and impact analysis. Providing this information to a Large-Language Model (LLM) is another hurdle, as the LLM must understand not only the required code method but also its associated methods in the grand scheme of the repository. We propose Code Comprehensor, a hybrid retrieval–reasoning framework combining (i) CodeGraph, a code dependency callgraph, (ii) CodeScribe, which uses code-aware LLMs to generate hierarchical documentation across repository call graphs, and (iii) CodeContrast, a CLIP-style dual-encoder model trained on CodeScribe output to learn aligned text-code embeddings. CodeContrast enables fast, semantically precise retrieval of relevant code-context neighborhoods, which serve as grounded evidence for an MCP-based LLM orchestrator answering domain-specific queries. Evaluation on OpenCV and a proprietary 5M-LOC repository shows that CodeScribe-derived supervision significantly improves cross-modal retrieval in text-to-code accuracy over baseline approaches. Richer textual supervision (hierarchical documentation, parent/sibling context, and LLM-generated synthetic questions) consistently enhances performance across both repositories. LLM-as-a-judge evaluation using the popular RAGAS of the Code Comprehensor output yields above 90% faithfulness scores.
paragraphs.zh: 理解大型、复杂且快速演进的代码库仍然是大规模软件工程面临的核心挑战，它阻碍了新人上手、维护、重构和影响分析。 将这些信息提供给大语言模型（LLM）是另一道难关，因为 LLM 不仅要理解所需的代码方法，还要理解其在整个仓库全局中相关联的方法。 我们提出 Code Comprehensor，这是一个混合检索—推理框架，结合了：(i) CodeGraph，一个代码依赖调用图；(ii) CodeScribe，利用具备代码感知能力的 LLM 在仓库调用图上生成分层文档；(iii) CodeContrast，一个 CLIP 风格的双编码器模型，基于 CodeScribe 的输出进行训练，以学习对齐的文本—代码嵌入。 CodeContrast 能够快速、语义精准地检索相关的代码上下文邻域，这些邻域可作为基于 MCP 的 LLM 编排器回答领域特定查询时的有据证据。 在 OpenCV 和一个 500 万行代码的私有仓库上的评估表明，基于 CodeScribe 的监督显著提升了基线方法在文本到代码检索准确率上的跨模态检索表现。 更丰富的文本监督（分层文档、父级/同级上下文以及 LLM 生成的合成问题）在两个仓库上均持续提升了性能。 使用流行的 RAGAS 对 Code Comprehensor 输出进行 LLM 即评审员评估，忠实度得分超过 90%。

paragraphs.en: Enterprises typically have large code repositories that have been developed and maintained over the years. The ability to document and understand such complex repositories has been a challenge [ 1 , 2 ] . Code complexity creates dependencies on senior engineers’ expertise to understand and navigate such repositories, and introduces inefficiencies in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) [ 3 ] . The growth of Large Language Models (LLM) in recent years and their ability to understand and explain code introduce the possibility of making this process more efficient [ 4 ] . This growth will lead to greater productivity in developing new features and maintaining and debugging existing ones.
paragraphs.zh: 企业通常拥有经过多年开发和维护的大型代码仓库。 对这类复杂仓库进行文档化和理解一直是一项挑战 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 代码的复杂性导致依赖资深工程师的专业知识来理解和浏览这类仓库，并给软件开发生命周期（SDLC）带来低效问题 [ 3 ] 。 近年来大语言模型（LLM）的发展及其理解和解释代码的能力，使让这一过程更加高效成为可能 [ 4 ] 。 这一发展将带来更高的生产力，用于开发新功能以及维护和调试现有功能。

paragraphs.en: However, the ability to use LLMs to document and understand large repositories in a reliable, replicable fashion requires careful design and consideration. Despite the large context window of many modern LLMs [ 5 ] , code repositories often will consume a much larger number of tokens. For example, [ 6 ] gives Lines of Code (LOC) for some public repositories, and token sizes will be much larger. Proprietary code repositories are often large in terms of LOC. For example, one of the repositories mentioned in this paper is larger than most listed in [ 6 ] . More importantly, just because an LLM can process a large number of tokens does not mean an LLM should access the entire repository for every question. In addition to cost implications, large context sizes are known to give poorer results [ 7 , 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，要可靠且可复现地使用大语言模型来记录和理解大型代码仓库，需要进行精心的设计与考量。 尽管许多现代大语言模型拥有很大的上下文窗口 [ 5 ] ，但代码仓库往往会消耗多得多的 token 数量。 例如， [ 6 ] 给出了一些公开代码仓库的代码行数（LOC），而 token 数量会大得多。 专有代码仓库在代码行数方面通常规模很大。 例如，本文提到的一个代码仓库比 [ 6 ] 中列出的大多数仓库都要大。 更重要的是，大语言模型能够处理大量 token，并不意味着它在回答每个问题时都应该访问整个代码仓库。 除了成本方面的考虑之外，已知过大的上下文规模会导致较差的结果 [ 7 , 8 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, code repositories often contain identical or very similar files, methods, and variables across different parts of the code base, and using probabilistic machinery like an LLM is unlikely to be reliable or replicable. In view of this, it is important to design systems that enable LLMs to navigate code repositories more consistently and deterministically. Regarding this issue, some studies discuss using the inherent structure of code, as captured in the call graph, to drive documentation. Work by [ 9 ] discusses using a static-analysis-based call tree to generate documentation for large-scale repositories recursively. A similar approach to generate initial and incremental documentation has been followed by other works [ 10 ] . A hierarchical engine for document generation and querying has also been studied [ 11 ] . Recently, Google released a repository to document code [ 12 ] ; however, to the best of our knowledge, the system’s design has not been disclosed. The common aspect of these repositories is the use of either the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) [ 13 ] or the call-graph. However, if one wants to build more than just static documentation, a broader and more comprehensive approach is needed. Previous work [ 14 , 15 ] has looked at cross-modal contrastive learning for code search; however, without deep domain-level documentation mapping methods to domain and code structure, the effectiveness of such cross-modal retrieval on large, complex repositories is limited.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，代码仓库在代码库的不同部分常常包含完全相同或非常相似的文件、方法和变量，而使用诸如大语言模型（LLM）这类概率性机制不太可能做到可靠或可复现。 有鉴于此，设计能够使大语言模型更一致、更确定性地导航代码仓库的系统十分重要。 针对这一问题，一些研究讨论了利用代码固有的结构（如调用图中所体现的）来驱动文档生成。 文献 [ 9 ] 的工作讨论了使用基于静态分析的调用树，以递归方式为大规模仓库生成文档。 其他工作 [ 10 ] 也采用了类似的方法来生成初始文档和增量文档。 用于文档生成与查询的层次化引擎也得到了研究 [ 11 ] 。 最近，Google 发布了一个用于文档化代码的仓库 [ 12 ] ；然而，据我们所知，该系统的设计尚未公开。 这些仓库的共同之处在于使用了抽象语法树（AST）[ 13 ] 或调用图。 然而，如果想要构建的不仅仅是静态文档，就需要一种更宽泛、更全面的方法。 已有工作 [ 14 , 15 ] 研究了用于代码搜索的跨模态对比学习；然而，在缺乏将文档映射到领域与代码结构的深层领域级方法的情况下，此类跨模态检索在大型复杂仓库上的效果是有限的。

paragraphs.en: We present Code Comprehensor , an end-to-end system that combines four main components: (i) CodeGraph , a call graph generated via static analysis and exposed through API endpoints for traversal and chunking; (ii) CodeScribe , a hierarchical documentation engine that recursively processes directory-structured code, supports multiple documentation chapters and custom prompts per directory, and outputs PlantUML diagrams; (iii) a custom data processing module that parses CodeScribe output into relational records linking methods to parent/sibling context; and (iv) CodeContrast , a CLIP-based dual-encoder contrastive model using InfoNCE loss for asymmetric text-to-code and code-to-text retrieval with multi-positive learning support.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Code Comprehensor，这是一个端到端系统，由四个主要组件组成：(i) CodeGraph，一个通过静态分析生成的调用图，并通过 API 端点暴露以支持遍历和分块；(ii) CodeScribe，一个分层文档生成引擎，递归处理目录结构的代码，支持多个文档章节及每个目录的自定义提示词，并输出 PlantUML 图；(iii) 一个自定义数据处理模块，将 CodeScribe 的输出解析为关联方法与父级/同级上下文的关系型记录；以及 (iv) CodeContrast，一个基于 CLIP 的双编码器对比模型，使用 InfoNCE 损失实现非对称的文本到代码和代码到文本检索，并支持多正样本学习。

paragraphs.en: CodeScribe operates on a repository directory structure with configurable chapter-based perspectives (e.g., code description, algorithms, data flow). For each start method (in-degree zero in the method subgraph), CodeScribe retrieves the Depth-First-Search (DFS) traversal tree via CodeGraph, chunks it if necessary using post-order traversal to preserve hierarchy, and generates documentation. CodeScribe supports both full and incremental (git-commit-driven) documentation runs.
paragraphs.zh: CodeScribe 在代码仓库目录结构上运行，并支持可配置的基于章节的视角（例如代码描述、算法、数据流）。 对于每个起始方法（方法子图中入度为零的方法），CodeScribe 通过 CodeGraph 获取深度优先搜索（DFS）遍历树，在必要时使用后序遍历对其进行分块以保留层级结构，并生成文档。 CodeScribe 同时支持全量与增量（由 git 提交驱动）的文档生成运行。

paragraphs.en: CodeContrast leverages the structured training data from CodeScribe parsing to train a retrieval model. We adopt CLIP’s dual-encoder architecture for efficient pre-computed embeddings and asymmetric modalities. The InfoNCE objective learns well-separated embedding spaces and extends naturally to multi-positive scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: CodeContrast 利用 CodeScribe 解析得到的结构化训练数据来训练一个检索模型。 我们采用 CLIP 的双编码器架构，以实现高效的预计算嵌入并处理非对称的模态。 InfoNCE 目标函数能够学习到分离良好的嵌入空间，并且可以自然地扩展到多正样本场景。

paragraphs.en: Finally, a Model Context Protocol (MCP) based orchestration layer integrates CodeGraph, CodeScribe, and CodeContrast into an agentic system accessible via an Integrated Development Environment (IDE). This Master Agent invokes specialized agents (RAG over CodeScribe output, CodeGraph traversal, CodeContrast retrieval) to answer domain-specific queries on code repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，一个基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的编排层将 CodeGraph、CodeScribe 和 CodeContrast 集成为一个可通过集成开发环境（IDE）访问的智能体系统。 该主智能体调用专门的智能体（对 CodeScribe 输出进行 RAG、CodeGraph 遍历、CodeContrast 检索），以回答有关代码仓库的领域特定查询。

paragraphs.en: The core contributions of this paper are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的核心贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: A post-order chunking algorithm that enables LLM documentation of arbitrarily large call trees while preserving structural hierarchy.
paragraphs.zh: 一种后序分块算法，可让大语言模型对任意大的调用树进行文档化，同时保留结构层级。

paragraphs.en: A multi-granularity training data construction pipeline that leverages parent-sibling relationships from documentation structure and LLM-generated synthetic questions for enhanced retrieval performance.
paragraphs.zh: 一个多粒度训练数据构建流水线，利用文档结构中的父级-同级关系以及由大语言模型生成的合成问题，以提升检索性能。

paragraphs.en: Code Comprehensor: an integrated end-to-end system combining CodeGraph, CodeScribe, and CodeContrast components for large-scale repository understanding and retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: Code Comprehensor：一个集成了 CodeGraph、CodeScribe 和 CodeContrast 组件的端到端系统，用于大规模代码库的理解与检索。

paragraphs.en: Empirical evidence that hierarchical documentation-derived supervision improves cross-modal code retrieval by at least 9% Top-1 accuracy over baseline approaches.

paragraphs.en: Code search and retrieval has been an active area of research for understanding large repositories. Recent work has focused on neural approaches combining text and code embeddings. Sun et al. [ 16 ] presented context-aware code translation for code search, while Chai et al. [ 17 ] explored cross-domain deep code search using meta-learning techniques. Mathew and Stolee [ 18 ] investigated cross-language code search, and Mao et al. [ 19 ] proposed self-supervised query reformulation for improved retrieval. More recently, Wang et al. [ 20 ] examined fusion of multiple code searchers, and Shi et al. [ 21 ] introduced CoCoSoDa for effective contrastive learning on code search tasks. Large-scale contrastive pre-training for code retrieval has been explored by Li et al. [ 22 ] , who developed CodeRetriever. Comprehensive surveys on code search have been provided by Di Grazia and Pradel [ 23 ] and Sun et al. [ 24 ] .

paragraphs.en: Code Comprehensor extends prior work in three key ways. First, unlike code search methods that operate on isolated code snippets (e.g., CodeRetriever, CoCoSoDa), our system first generates hierarchical documentation that captures inter-method relationships through call graph analysis and multi-perspective documentation generation, then trains a contrastive model on this enriched representation. Prior work on code retrieval has focused primarily on Python and Java; CodeRetriever and CoCoSoDa lack publicly available implementations for C/C++ repositories, limiting direct empirical comparison on the systems programming domain where our work is evaluated. Second, unlike RepoAgent, which focuses solely on documentation generation, our system uses the generated documentation as a structured training signal for a retrieval model, enabling efficient inference-time retrieval without requiring LLM calls per query. Third, we employ a post-order chunking algorithm to handle arbitrarily large call trees while preserving structural hierarchy, enabling scalable documentation and retrieval on repositories exceeding 5M lines of code.
paragraphs.zh: Code Comprehensor 在三个方面对已有工作进行了关键扩展。 首先，与作用于孤立代码片段的代码检索方法（如 CodeRetriever、CoCoSoDa）不同，我们的系统先通过调用图分析和多视角文档生成来构建刻画方法间关系的层次化文档，然后在这一丰富表示上训练对比模型。 已有的代码检索工作主要集中于 Python 和 Java；CodeRetriever 和 CoCoSoDa 缺乏针对 C/C++ 代码库的公开实现，这限制了在我们工作所评估的系统编程领域上进行直接的实证比较。 其次，与仅专注于文档生成的 RepoAgent 不同，我们的系统将生成的文档作为检索模型的结构化训练信号，从而实现高效的推理时检索，而无需对每个查询调用大语言模型（LLM）。 第三，我们采用后序分块算法来处理任意规模的调用树，同时保留结构层次，使得对超过 500 万行代码的代码库进行可扩展的文档生成与检索成为可能。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows the overall system architecture for Code Comprehensor. Git repositories are first cloned into our system, and the CodeGraph is generated using static analysis. This CodeGraph is then consumed in CodeScribe, which uses two additional external information sources: prompts and configuration files. These are discussed in detail in Section IV-B . The output of CodeScribe, called “Synthesized Technical Descriptions” (SynTD), is consumed by CodeContrast. CodeScribe uses recursive synthesis (shown as “S” in Figure 1 ) indicated by the self-loop. To enable an end user (or an external system/agent) to interact with the documentation, multiple custom agents are built. The end user interacts with the Master Agent (MA) via an MCP gateway. The MA is an LLM-based orchestrator that calls multiple specialized agents. The CodeScribe Agent is an RAG-based system on the SynTD. There is a CodeContrast agent that can invoke API calls on the trained contrastive model. The CodeGraph agent can perform custom traversals on the CodeGraph via an exposed API.

paragraphs.en: Given a natural-language question from the user (an Engineer in this example), the MA retrieves relevant code blocks from the CodeContrast agent using Text → \rightarrow Code-based retrieval. The MA retrieves the hierarchy of the relevant methods from the CodeGraph agent and obtains their documentation using the CodeScribe Agent. Finally, the MA composes a natural-language response to the end user and adds relevant diagrams and code blocks to provide a more comprehensive answer. The end user can interact further with the MA with follow-up questions. The Engineer can also ask questions, such as explanations of specific files, methods, or classes, and their relevance to the overall system. In such a case, MA uses the Code → \rightarrow Text retrieval from the CM agent. It also identifies the method or file hierarchy from the CodeGraph agent and the documentation from the CodeScribe Agent. The MA decides which type of retrieval to invoke from the CodeContrast agent. This system allows for seamless end-to-end navigation and interpretation of the repository.

paragraphs.en: To create the CodeGraph, a static analysis of the code repository is first performed. Static analysis identifies all code files and their corresponding methods. Dependencies are resolved via compile commands or, if unavailable, with reasonable heuristics. Node types are files and methods, and in object-oriented languages, other node types, such as classes, are added. Comments written by the developer for the methods are also extracted as attributes for the method nodes in CodeGraph, along with the method signatures. For methods without a developer-written comment, an LLM is prompted to generate one. The actual method body is also available as an attribute on the method. Since the same method can appear in multiple files, nodes are named “ method_name:::file_name ” where “:::” is chosen as the separator since it is unlikely to appear elsewhere. In object-oriented languages, nodes are named “ method_name:::file_name ::::line_number” to handle operator overloading. Method names include the namespace and class name, where relevant, as fully qualified names. The Tree-Sitter library [ 29 ] is used for parsing, though other approaches can be used. The CodeGraph generation, of course, needs (programming) language-specific parsing. The CodeGraph structure is generic, and the rest of the processing in the entire system is language-agnostic.
paragraphs.zh: 为了创建 CodeGraph，首先对代码仓库进行静态分析。 静态分析会识别所有代码文件及其对应的方法。 依赖关系通过编译命令来解析，如果编译命令不可用，则采用合理的启发式方法。 节点类型为文件和方法，在面向对象语言中，还会添加其他节点类型，例如类。 开发者为方法编写的注释也会与方法签名一起，被提取为 CodeGraph 中方法节点的属性。 对于没有开发者编写注释的方法，会提示 LLM 生成一条注释。 实际的方法体也可作为方法的一个属性使用。 由于同一个方法可能出现在多个文件中，节点被命名为「method_name:::file_name」，其中选择「:::」作为分隔符，因为它不太可能出现在其他地方。 在面向对象语言中，为了处理运算符重载，节点被命名为「method_name:::file_name ::::line_number」。 在相关情况下，方法名包含命名空间和类名，即使用完全限定名。 解析使用的是 Tree-Sitter 库 [ 29 ]，不过也可以使用其他方法。 当然，CodeGraph 的生成需要针对特定（编程）语言的解析。 CodeGraph 的结构是通用的，而整个系统中其余的处理过程与语言无关。

sents.en: Since the same method can appear in multiple files, nodes are named “ method_name:::file_name ” where “:::” is chosen as the separator since it is unlikely to appear elsewhere.

paragraphs.en: The CodeGraph is saved as a Python Networkx [ 30 ] library object. This CodeGraph is also exposed through a FastAPI service [ 31 ] . Several endpoints are exposed via the FastAPI service. Most are standard endpoints for graph traversal, e.g., Breadth-First-Search (BFS) and Depth-First-Search (DFS), along with the “invokes” edge in both forward and reverse directions. The resultant CodeGraph and the endpoints are used to generate the documents using CodeScribe.

paragraphs.en: CodeScribe documentation is driven by the repository’s directory structure because that is the natural way developers navigate it. The output of CodeScribe is Markdown files in a directory structure that replicates the code repository’s directories. CodeScribe has configuration files that allow one to exclude irrelevant directories and include only file name extensions that are present. Every directory can have one or more perspectives to document the code, called “chapters” (e.g., code description, algorithms, data flow, interfaces). For each chapter, a custom prompt is generated, with flexibility to customize per directory. CodeScribe can also consume configuration information, such as abbreviation lists for specialized domains.

paragraphs.en: The system prompts are designed with three key principles: (1) LLM output is constrained to generate documents at hierarchical levels of abstraction, summarizing at appropriate semantic boundaries; (2) quoted code segments are marked with metadata (method name, file path, language) to enable downstream parsing and tracing back to source; (3) consistency across documentation perspectives ensures coherent multi-chapter views of the same code units. These design choices are critical for downstream parsing and contrastive model training.
paragraphs.zh: 系统提示词遵循三个关键原则设计：(1) 约束大语言模型的输出，使其按层次化的抽象级别生成文档，并在合适的语义边界处进行摘要；(2) 引用的代码片段附带元数据（方法名、文件路径、语言），以便下游解析并回溯到源代码；(3) 保证不同文档视角之间的一致性，从而对相同代码单元形成连贯的多章节视图。 这些设计选择对下游解析和对比模型训练至关重要。

paragraphs.en: When processing any directory, CodeScribe invokes CodeGraph to find all files in the directory and the methods they contain. Next, among the methods it identifies, start methods are those with an in-degree of zero in the method-only subgraph (a subgraph consisting only of methods). These methods are invoked by the external system (outside the scope of the current module graph). For each start method, the DFS traversal tree is retrieved via an endpoint on the CodeGraph API. The DFS traversal endpoint generates a key for each element in the DFS walk, and this information is included in the LLM’s context. The context also includes the method definitions in the DFS tree. Thus, there is one Markdown output file per chapter and per start method. The documents for each start method are then combined for a summarized document at the directory level. Optionally, via a configuration file, summarizations for directory hierarchies are also done.

paragraphs.en: However, in large repositories, it is common to find trees that exceed the allowable context window, especially since method definitions are included. It is important to note that context sizes include output tokens, and there must be a reasonable allowance left for the LLM to generate sufficiently detailed documentation. This requires that the DFS walk trees be properly chunked. Hence, we build a chunking process that allows customizable chunk sizes. To handle such large trees, we implement an algorithm that uses recursive post-order traversal to process the DFS tree. For each node, we first process all children recursively, collecting any remaining chunks. We then check if the current node plus all child remainders fit within the primary context limit. If so, we merge them. If not, we finalize each child remainder as an independent chunk and keep only the current node. Finally, if the resulting chunk exceeds the primary limit plus a buffer, we split it into overflow chunks and return the remaining tail.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在大型代码仓库中，经常会遇到超出允许上下文窗口的树，尤其是由于其中包含了方法定义。 需要注意的是，上下文大小包含输出 token，并且必须为 LLM 留出合理的余量，以便生成足够详细的文档。 这就要求对 DFS 遍历树进行合理的分块。 因此，我们构建了一个允许自定义分块大小的分块流程。 为了处理如此大的树，我们实现了一种使用递归后序遍历来处理 DFS 树的算法。 对于每个节点，我们首先递归处理其所有子节点，并收集剩余的分块。 然后检查当前节点加上所有子节点剩余部分是否能容纳在主上下文限制之内。如果可以，则将它们合并。 如果不可以，则将每个子节点剩余部分确定为一个独立的分块，并仅保留当前节点。 最后，如果生成的分块超过主限制加上一个缓冲区，我们将其拆分为溢出分块并返回剩余的尾部。

paragraphs.en: The chunks are presented to the LLM as context, and the output of the previous chunk is added to future chunks in the context in a recursive generation process. The output of intermediate chunks is temporary and not included in the final documentation. Our algorithm ensures that when the LLM processes a parent caller, it possesses a high-level functional summary of all callee implementations, even if the source code of those children is not included in the current active window. This rolling summarization effectively compresses the global DFS walk state, allowing the model to generate accurate parent-level documentation without having to guess the behavior of its dependencies.

paragraphs.en: CodeScribe can also process incrementals based on git commit IDs. This process can be done by identifying the last processed git commit and identifying files that have changed. Further to this, the methods in these impacted files are identified and checked against the previous version of the graph to see if they have changed. If they have, then the root/start methods of the trees they belong to are identified. This method is shown in Figure 2 . Once this is done, CodeScribe asks the LLM to modify only the start methods and any summarization documents generated for this. This process allows incremental processing at any frequency, from periodic intervals such as weekly to integration with Continuous Integration/Continuous Development (CI/CD) pipelines. CodeScribe’s output is then parsed into a more palatable data format for CodeContrast.

paragraphs.en: To utilize this data for training CodeContrast, the Markdown files undergo several processes:

paragraphs.en: A custom recursive parser was implemented to convert Markdown documents into nested JSON structures. The headers and subheaders of the Markdown file become the keys of the JSON file. Non-header content is aggregated under an arbitrary key at the appropriate nesting level. This approach preserves the hierarchical organization of the original documentation while enabling programmatic traversal.
paragraphs.zh: 实现了一个自定义的递归解析器，用于将 Markdown 文档转换为嵌套的 JSON 结构。 Markdown 文件的标题和子标题成为 JSON 文件的键。 非标题内容被聚合到相应嵌套层级的一个任意键之下。 这种方法在保留原始文档层级结构的同时，支持以编程方式进行遍历。

sents.en: A custom recursive parser was implemented to convert Markdown documents into nested JSON structures.
sents.zh: 实现了一个自定义的递归解析器，用于将 Markdown 文档转换为嵌套的 JSON 结构。

sents.en: The headers and subheaders of the Markdown file become the keys of the JSON file.
sents.zh: Markdown 文件的标题和子标题成为 JSON 文件的键。

sents.en: Non-header content is aggregated under an arbitrary key at the appropriate nesting level.
sents.zh: 非标题内容被聚合到相应嵌套层级的一个任意键之下。

sents.en: This approach preserves the hierarchical organization of the original documentation while enabling programmatic traversal.
sents.zh: 这种方法在保留原始文档层级结构的同时，支持以编程方式进行遍历。

paragraphs.en: Each leaf node in the resulting JSON tree is processed to separate the code blocks from the text segments. A regex-based extractor identifies fenced code blocks (delimited by triple backticks) and captures both the language identifier and the source code. The remaining text, after code block removal, is retained as a description. The extraction procedure traverses the JSON tree recursively, assigning a dot-separated depth identifier (e.g., 1.2.3) to each node. This depth encoding enables the subsequent identification of parent-child and sibling relationships among extracted entries, which is critical for constructing the relational features of the final dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 对生成的JSON树中的每个叶子节点进行处理，将代码块与文本段分离。 基于正则表达式的提取器识别围栏代码块（由三个反引号定界），并同时捕获语言标识符和源代码。 移除代码块后剩余的文本被保留作为描述。 提取过程递归地遍历JSON树，为每个节点分配一个以点分隔的深度标识符（例如，1.2.3）。 这种深度编码使得后续能够识别所提取条目之间的父子关系和兄弟关系，这对构建最终数据集的关系特征至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Each extracted code block is classified into one of three categories based on its content:
paragraphs.zh: 每个提取的代码块根据其内容被分类为以下三个类别之一：

paragraphs.en: Code : Blocks containing annotated source code with explicit method name and file path metadata (extracted via inline comments from CodeScribe).
paragraphs.zh: Code：包含带注解源代码的代码块，附带显式的方法名和文件路径元数据（通过 CodeScribe 的内联注释提取）。

paragraphs.en: UML : Blocks identified as PlantUML specifications, detected by the presence of @startuml directives or the PlantUML language identifier.
paragraphs.zh: UML：被识别为 PlantUML 规范的代码块，通过是否存在 @startuml 指令或 PlantUML 语言标识符来检测。

paragraphs.en: Pseudocode : Code blocks lacking method name and file path annotations, treated as pseudocode or algorithmic sketches.
paragraphs.zh: 伪代码：缺少方法名和文件路径标注的代码块，被视为伪代码或算法草图。

paragraphs.en: For each code entry, the pipeline constructs a rich set of relational features by using the depth-encoded tree structure from CodeScribe:
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个代码条目，流水线利用 CodeScribe 的深度编码树结构来构建一组丰富的关系特征：

paragraphs.en: Parent context : Textual descriptions from the immediate parent node, providing high-level context.
paragraphs.zh: 父上下文：来自直接父节点的文本描述，提供高层级上下文。

paragraphs.en: Sibling context : Method names, comments, file paths, and code of entries sharing the same parent, capturing co-located functionality.
paragraphs.zh: 同级上下文：共享同一父级条目的方法名、注释、文件路径和代码，用于捕获同处一地的相关功能。

paragraphs.en: Module-level context : Aggregated commentary from text-only nodes that lack direct child code blocks, serving as overarching module documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 模块级上下文：来自缺乏直接子代码块的纯文本节点的汇总注释，用作整体性的模块文档。

paragraphs.en: These relational features are designed to provide the contrastive learning model with multi-granularity contextual signals linking code to its surrounding documentation. The parsed records are merged with the call graph data created earlier, using the same composite key of the form “ method_name:::file_path ”
paragraphs.zh: 这些关系特征旨在为对比学习模型提供多粒度的上下文信号，将代码与其周围的文档关联起来。 解析后的记录会与先前创建的调用图数据合并，使用形式为“ method_name:::file_path ”的相同复合键。

sents.en: These relational features are designed to provide the contrastive learning model with multi-granularity contextual signals linking code to its surrounding documentation.
sents.zh: 这些关系特征旨在为对比学习模型提供多粒度的上下文信号，将代码与其周围的文档关联起来。

sents.en: The parsed records are merged with the call graph data created earlier, using the same composite key of the form “ method_name:::file_path ”
sents.zh: 解析后的记录会与先前创建的调用图数据合并，使用形式为“ method_name:::file_path ”的相同复合键。

paragraphs.en: Large repositories often have sparse, inconsistent, or outdated data (e.g., missing comments, legacy documentation, or domain-specific abbreviations). Moreover, real developer queries often take the form of questions rather than direct text descriptions. Therefore, to improve coverage and better match downstream retrieval and reasoning workloads, synthetic questions generated from the parsed records are augmented, with code included only as a grounding aid.
paragraphs.zh: 大型仓库中的数据往往稀疏、不一致或过时（例如，缺少注释、遗留文档或领域特定缩写）。 此外，真实开发者的查询往往以问题的形式出现，而非直接的文本描述。 因此，为了提高覆盖率并更好地匹配下游检索与推理工作负载，我们对从解析记录生成的合成问题进行了增强，代码仅作为锚定辅助手段包含其中。

sents.en: Large repositories often have sparse, inconsistent, or outdated data (e.g., missing comments, legacy documentation, or domain-specific abbreviations).
sents.zh: 大型仓库中的数据往往稀疏、不一致或过时（例如，缺少注释、遗留文档或领域特定缩写）。

sents.en: Moreover, real developer queries often take the form of questions rather than direct text descriptions.
sents.zh: 此外，真实开发者的查询往往以问题的形式出现，而非直接的文本描述。

sents.en: Therefore, to improve coverage and better match downstream retrieval and reasoning workloads, synthetic questions generated from the parsed records are augmented, with code included only as a grounding aid.
sents.zh: 因此，为了提高覆盖率并更好地匹配下游检索与推理工作负载，我们对从解析记录生成的合成问题进行了增强，代码仅作为锚定辅助手段包含其中。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic questions are constructed with two explicit objectives:
paragraphs.zh: 合成问题的构建有两个明确的目标：

paragraphs.en: Intent diversity : cover common developer intents such as purpose/behavior, parameter usage, edge cases, and preconditions, error handling, and interactions within a local module context.
paragraphs.zh: 意图多样性：涵盖常见的开发者意图，例如目的/行为、参数用法、边界情况与前置条件、错误处理，以及局部模块上下文内的交互。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval grounding : include repository-specific terminology (parameter names, types, macros, struct/enum identifiers, and field names) to improve retrievability, while explicitly discouraging “keyword dumping”.
paragraphs.zh: 检索落地（Retrieval grounding）：包含仓库特定的术语（参数名、类型、宏、结构体/枚举标识符及字段名）以提高可检索性，同时明确反对“关键词堆砌”。

paragraphs.en: In our pipeline, the semantic intent of each question is primarily driven by the available documentation signal. At the same time, the method signature and a bounded code snippet are used as auxiliary sources for terminology anchors.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的流程中，每个问题的语义意图主要由可用的文档信号驱动。 同时，方法签名和有界的代码片段被用作术语锚点的辅助来源。

sents.en: In our pipeline, the semantic intent of each question is primarily driven by the available documentation signal.
sents.zh: 在我们的流程中，每个问题的语义意图主要由可用的文档信号驱动。

sents.en: At the same time, the method signature and a bounded code snippet are used as auxiliary sources for terminology anchors.
sents.zh: 同时，方法签名和有界的代码片段被用作术语锚点的辅助来源。

paragraphs.en: Each synthetic question set is generated for a single code entry produced by Section IV-C .
paragraphs.zh: 每个合成问题集都是针对 Section IV-C 产生的单个代码条目生成的。

paragraphs.en: For a given entry, the generation payload consists of:
paragraphs.zh: 对于给定的条目，生成载荷（generation payload）包括：

paragraphs.en: Documentation signal : one consolidated text slice corresponding to a selected comment level or hierarchical comment fields when available.
paragraphs.zh: 文档信号：对应所选评论级别或分层评论字段（若可用）的一个合并文本切片。

paragraphs.en: Code signal : the method signature and a bounded code snippet (provided for terminology only, with explicit instructions not to copy verbatim). We provide a signature with the symbol name removed.
paragraphs.zh: 代码信号：方法签名和一段有界限的代码片段（仅用于提供术语参考，并明确指示不得逐字复制）。 我们提供了一个已移除符号名称的签名。

sents.en: Code signal : the method signature and a bounded code snippet (provided for terminology only, with explicit instructions not to copy verbatim).
sents.zh: 代码信号：方法签名和一段有界限的代码片段（仅用于提供术语参考，并明确指示不得逐字复制）。

sents.en: We provide a signature with the symbol name removed.
sents.zh: 我们提供了一个已移除符号名称的签名。

paragraphs.en: The generator, therefore, receives a comment-driven description of behavior, augmented with a limited amount of code-local context.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，生成器接收的是一个由注释驱动的行为描述，并辅以少量的代码局部上下文。

paragraphs.en: To encourage grounded and retrievable questions, we extract candidate anchors from the entry:
paragraphs.zh: 为鼓励有依据、可检索的问题，我们从词条中提取候选锚点：

paragraphs.en: Behavior anchors ( BEHAVIOR_ANCHORS ): action-level intent tokens (verbs) that constrain question semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 行为锚点（ BEHAVIOR_ANCHORS ）：约束问题语义的动作级意图标记（动词）。

paragraphs.en: Parameter anchors ( PARAM_TERMS ): parameter names and salient type tokens parsed from the function signature.
paragraphs.zh: 参数锚点（ PARAM_TERMS ）：从函数签名中解析出的参数名称和显著的类型标记。

paragraphs.en: Context anchors ( CONTEXT_TERMS ): repository- and domain-specific terminology mined from the documentation slice and the bounded code context.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文锚点（CONTEXT_TERMS）：从文档片段和有界代码上下文中挖掘出的、特定于仓库和领域的术语。

paragraphs.en: Key terms ( KEY_TERMS ): a capped union of parameter and context anchors, used as a lexical grounding constraint while limiting the total number of enforced tokens to avoid keyword stuffing.
paragraphs.zh: 关键术语（KEY_TERMS）：由参数和上下文锚点组成的、设有上限的并集，用作词汇层面的接地约束，同时限制强制执行的总词元数量，以避免关键词堆砌。

paragraphs.en: We use a code-capable instruction-following LLM to generate synthetic questions. 1 1 1 We use [GEN_MODEL] with decoding parameters [TEMP] , [TOP_P] , and [MAX_TOKENS] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个具备代码能力的指令跟随大语言模型来生成合成问题。1 1 1 我们使用 [GEN_MODEL]，解码参数为 [TEMP]、[TOP_P] 和 [MAX_TOKENS]。

paragraphs.en: For each entry, the prompt instructs the generator to produce developer-style questions with the following rules:
paragraphs.zh: 对于每一条目，提示词会指示生成器按照以下规则生成开发者风格的问题：

paragraphs.en: Reflect the described behavior and constraints from the documentation signal;
paragraphs.zh: 从文档信号中反映所描述的行为和约束；

paragraphs.en: includes at least two terminology anchors (preferably one from PARAM_TERMS and one from CONTEXT_TERMS when available), and at least three verbatim hits from KEY_TERMS ;
paragraphs.zh: 至少包含两个术语锚点（在可用时，最好一个来自 PARAM_TERMS，一个来自 CONTEXT_TERMS），并且至少有三个来自 KEY_TERMS 的逐字匹配项；

paragraphs.en: Include at least one BEHAVIOR_ANCHORS (e.g., validate , initialize , convert , decode ) to reduce purely token-driven outputs, while discouraging keyword dumping;
paragraphs.zh: 包含至少一个 BEHAVIOR_ANCHORS（例如 validate、initialize、convert、decode）以减少纯粹由 token 驱动的输出，同时抑制关键词堆砌；

paragraphs.en: Enforce interrogative form (each question ends with ‘?’);
paragraphs.zh: 强制使用疑问句形式（每个问题以「?」结尾）；

paragraphs.en: Avoid copying code verbatim and avoid dataset-specific identifiers (e.g., <path>:<line> strings).
paragraphs.zh: 避免逐字复制代码，并避免使用特定于数据集的标识符（例如，<path>:<line> 形式的字符串）。

paragraphs.en: This design yields questions whose intent is comment-driven, while code-derived anchors improve grounding and retrieval utility. Listing 3 shows an example prompt used for synthetic question generation. We instruct the model to produce exactly three developer-style questions for each method.
paragraphs.zh: 这种设计产生的的问题是意图由注释驱动的问题，而由代码提取的锚点则提升了定位能力和检索实用性。 列表 3 展示了用于合成问题生成的一个提示词示例。 我们指示模型为每个方法恰好生成三个开发者风格的问题。

sents.en: This design yields questions whose intent is comment-driven, while code-derived anchors improve grounding and retrieval utility.
sents.zh: 这种设计产生的的问题是意图由注释驱动的问题，而由代码提取的锚点则提升了定位能力和检索实用性。

sents.en: Listing 3 shows an example prompt used for synthetic question generation.
sents.zh: 列表 3 展示了用于合成问题生成的一个提示词示例。

sents.en: We instruct the model to produce exactly three developer-style questions for each method.
sents.zh: 我们指示模型为每个方法恰好生成三个开发者风格的问题。

paragraphs.en: We apply lightweight filtering to improve precision and reduce noise:
paragraphs.zh: 我们对数据应用轻量级过滤，以提高精度并减少噪声：

paragraphs.en: Format and alignment checks : enforce strict JSON output and validate echoed tags; discard malformed outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 格式与对齐检查：强制执行严格的 JSON 输出并验证回显的标签；丢弃格式错误的输出。

paragraphs.en: Deduplication : remove exact and near-duplicate questions within the same ID.
paragraphs.zh: 去重：删除同一 ID 内完全重复和近似重复的问题。

paragraphs.en: Informativeness : discard questions that do not contain the required anchors or fall below a minimum length.
paragraphs.zh: 信息量：丢弃不包含所需锚点或低于最小长度的问题。

paragraphs.en: To assess retrieval generalization beyond trivial lexical shortcuts, we additionally evaluate a post-processed variant where function-name tokens are removed from questions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估超越简单词汇捷径的检索泛化能力，我们还额外评估了一种后处理变体，即从问题中移除函数名标记。

paragraphs.en: CodeContrast is a custom dual-encoder contrastive learning system [ 32 ] that aligns natural-language documentation embeddings with source-code embeddings. The system is designed for a code retrieval task: given a textual query (e.g., documentation or comments), retrieve the most relevant code snippet from a corpus, and vice versa. It uses PyTorch’s Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) [ 33 ] for distributed multi-GPU training, supports both SentenceTransformer (SBERT) [ 34 ] and normal BERT Transformer [ 35 ] backbones, and includes a full pipeline from data preparation through training, embedding store creation, and evaluation. The full architecture is shown in Figure 4 .
paragraphs.zh: CodeContrast 是一个自定义的双编码器对比学习系统[32]，用于将自然语言文档的嵌入与源代码的嵌入对齐。 该系统面向代码检索任务设计：给定一个文本查询（例如文档或注释），从语料库中检索出最相关的代码片段，反之亦然。 它使用 PyTorch 的全分片数据并行（FSDP）[33]进行分布式多 GPU 训练，同时支持 SentenceTransformer（SBERT）[34]和普通 BERT Transformer[35]骨干网络，并包含从数据准备、训练、嵌入库创建到评估的完整流水线。 完整架构如图 4 所示。

It loads a JSON input file that is created from Section IV-C , and applies validation and filtering logic to produce structured entries containing code, documentation, unique identifiers, and query types. This induces a one-to-many supervision structure: one code unit corresponds to many valid textual descriptions:
paragraphs.zh: 该模块作为数据处理流水线的初始阶段。 它加载由第IV-C节生成的JSON输入文件，并应用验证和过滤逻辑，以生成包含代码、文档、唯一标识符和查询类型的结构化条目。 这形成了一对多的监督结构：一个代码单元对应多个有效的文本描述：

sents.en: This module serves as the initial stage of the data‑processing pipeline.
sents.zh: 该模块作为数据处理流水线的初始阶段。

sents.en: It loads a JSON input file that is created from Section IV-C , and applies validation and filtering logic to produce structured entries containing code, documentation, unique identifiers, and query types.
sents.zh: 它加载由第IV-C节生成的JSON输入文件，并应用验证和过滤逻辑，以生成包含代码、文档、唯一标识符和查询类型的结构化条目。

sents.zh: 这形成了一对多的监督结构：一个代码单元对应多个有效的文本描述：

paragraphs.zh: 一个单一代码单元（方法签名和有界代码片段），以及

paragraphs.en: During this step, the system also flags entries that may cause issues, such as those with insufficient documentation or code that is too long to process effectively. Once everything is cleaned and organized, the module splits the data into training, validation, and test sets and then saves the final outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一步骤中，系统还会标记可能引起问题的条目，例如文档不足或代码过长而无法有效处理的条目。 当所有数据都清理和整理完毕后，该模块会将数据拆分为训练集、验证集和测试集，然后保存最终输出。

sents.en: Once everything is cleaned and organized, the module splits the data into training, validation, and test sets and then saves the final outputs.

paragraphs.en: The embedding system supports several backbone options. In one setup, we use SBERT encoders, which produce sentence embeddings directly. In another, we use Transformer models such as BERT, where we create fixed-size representations either by averaging the contextual token embeddings or by taking the final token embedding. To make sure these different backbones produce vectors of the same size, we optionally add a projection layer that maps everything to a shared dimension d d . All embeddings are then ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized onto the unit hypersphere, enabling cosine similarity to be computed by dot product.

paragraphs.en: A dual‑encoder framework integrates these embedding models in a unified contrastive learning setup. Each encoder processes either a text query or a code snippet, and both are trained jointly using a similarity objective that is adjusted by a temperature parameter. Because training runs across several devices, we gather embeddings from all GPUs to form a single global similarity matrix. This lets the model compare every item in the batch to all others, increasing the number of negative examples and effectively creating a much larger batch. In practice, this leads to more stable training and stronger contrastive representations.
paragraphs.zh: 双编码器框架将这些嵌入模型整合到统一的对比学习设置中。 每个编码器分别处理文本查询或代码片段，并通过由温度参数调节的相似性目标对二者进行联合训练。 由于训练在多个设备上运行，我们汇聚所有 GPU 上的嵌入以构建单一的全局相似性矩阵。 这使模型能够将批次中的每个条目与所有其他条目进行比较，从而增加负样本数量，实际上相当于创建了规模大得多的批次。 在实践中，这带来了更稳定的训练和更强的对比表示。

paragraphs.en: We use the Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) paradigm for training - this runs across multiple devices, so we bring all embeddings and labels together into one global batch before computing the similarity matrix. This gives the model a much larger set of negatives and keeps the contrastive comparisons consistent across GPUs. To make this work, we use a differentiable all‑gather operation that allows gradients to flow through the gathered tensors, which keeps the entire contrastive objective fully trainable even in a distributed setup. For safety, any rank that produces an empty batch still participates in the gather using placeholder tensors. This avoids synchronization issues and prevents the training process from stalling.

paragraphs.en: The objective of the testing phase is to assess how effectively the model retrieves the correct code function when provided with a natural language query (Text → \rightarrow Code), and how well it identifies the appropriate textual description when given a code snippet (Code → \rightarrow Text). The evaluation uses a held‑out test set consisting of methods paired with their corresponding text–code samples. Each sample includes a function along with all associated textual descriptions, such as raw docstrings, brief comments, self‑comments, and synthetic questions. None of the test methods or their synthetic variants are included in the training data, which ensures fair and unbiased assessment. Two types of tests are conducted. The first is the non‑synthetic test, which pairs each code sample with its original human‑authored (or LLM-authored when absent) textual descriptions. The second is the synthetic test, which augments each original pair with LLM-generated questions derived from the same function, as described in Section IV-D .

paragraphs.en: In addition to testing for the accuracy of CodeContrast, we also do an evaluation for testing the output of the Code Comprehensor system by using LLM-as-a-judge for the output of the MA. As this is a subjective evaluation, we use the RAGAS framework [ 36 ] . In particular, we use the Answer Correctness (AC) and Faithfulness (FF) metrics of this framework; earlier studies have shown that these have the best correlation with ground truth [ 37 ] . This evaluation is done on a subset of the synthetic questions; the generated answer from the MA is compared with the ground-truth answer used at the time the synthetic questions were generated.
paragraphs.zh: 除了测试 CodeContrast 的准确性之外，我们还进行了一项评估，通过使用 LLM 作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）来测试智能体（MA）输出的 Code Comprehensor 系统的表现。 由于这是一种主观评估，我们使用了 RAGAS 框架 [ 36 ]。 具体而言，我们使用了该框架中的答案正确性（AC）和忠实性（FF）指标；已有研究表明，这些指标与真实答案具有最佳的相关性 [ 37 ]。 该评估在合成问题的一个子集上进行；将智能体（MA）生成的答案与生成合成问题时使用的真实答案进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The practical deployment of Code Comprehensor requires an understanding of resource requirements. CodeScribe generation for OpenCV (1.2M LOC) required approximately 48 hours and $3,200 USD in LLM API costs using Sonnet 4.5. For Repo-A (5M LOC), the generation required approximately 8 days and a few thousand USD. CodeContrast training on 4 NVIDIA A100 GPUs converged in 15 epochs over approximately 24 hours. Inference is significantly more efficient: CodeContrast retrieval requires only a forward pass through the text encoder followed by cosine similarity computation against pre-computed code embeddings, achieving < < 50 ms latency per query. The full Master Agent pipeline (text-to-code retrieval + context assembly + LLM response generation) averages 3-5 seconds per query, depending on the result set size and the complexity of the response synthesis. These costs are one-time for initial documentation generation and model training; incremental updates (triggered by code changes) cost significantly less per month.
paragraphs.zh: Code Comprehensor 的实际部署需要对资源需求有所了解。 使用 Sonnet 4.5 为 OpenCV（120 万行代码）生成 CodeScribe 大约耗时 48 小时，LLM API 成本约为 3,200 美元。 对于 Repo-A（500 万行代码），生成大约耗时 8 天，成本为数千美元。 CodeContrast 在 4 块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上进行训练，大约 24 小时内经过 15 个 epoch 后收敛。 推理的效率则显著更高：CodeContrast 的检索只需通过文本编码器进行一次前向传播，然后与预先计算的代码嵌入进行余弦相似度计算，每次查询的延迟小于 50 毫秒。 完整的主智能体流水线（文本到代码检索 + 上下文组装 + LLM 响应生成）平均每次查询耗时 3–5 秒，具体取决于结果集大小和响应合成的复杂度。 这些成本对于初始文档生成和模型训练而言是一次性的；增量更新（由代码变更触发）每月的成本要低得多。

paragraphs.en: To study how different levels of natural language supervision influence cross-modal retrieval, we define three dataset configurations, D1 through D3. Each configuration adds an additional layer of textual descriptions to the same code elements. This gradual buildup allows us to clearly observe how various comment types and question-answer styles affect the model’s ability to generalize.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究不同级别的自然语言监督如何影响跨模态检索，我们定义了三种数据集配置，即 D1 到 D3。 每种配置都在相同的代码元素上添加一层额外的文本描述。 这种逐步累积的方式使我们能够清晰地观察各种注释类型和问答风格如何影响模型的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: D3 introduces higher‑level relational documentation by adding parent and sibling comments extracted from the CodeScribe output. D3, therefore, represents the richest supervision setting, capturing both local method semantics and global contextual semantics.

paragraphs.en: The results across both repositories demonstrate the nuanced benefits of incorporating CodeScribe-generated information into the CodeContrast pipeline. In Table I , the Top-1 accuracy overall for OpenCV is 66.05% for D2 and is 80.64% for D3, showing an improvement of 14.59%. Similarly, for Repo-A, we get 8.72% improvement (67.6% for D2 and 76.18% for D3). In Table II , for non-synthetic tests on human-authored descriptions, D2 achieves superior performance: on OpenCV’s doc_brief_merged category, D2 achieves Top-1 accuracy of 96.43% while D3 achieves 93.94%. This indicates that adding parent/sibling context and synthetic QA can reduce performance when evaluating against developer-authored comments.
paragraphs.zh: 两个代码库的结果都表明，将 CodeScribe 生成的信息纳入 CodeContrast 流水线能带来细微的收益。 在表 I 中，OpenCV 的整体 Top-1 准确率在 D2 上为 66.05%，在 D3 上为 80.64%，提升了 14.59%。 类似地，对于 Repo-A，我们获得了 8.72% 的提升（D2 为 67.6%，D3 为 76.18%）。 在表 II 中，针对基于人工撰写描述的非合成测试，D2 取得了更优的性能：在 OpenCV 的 doc_brief_merged 类别上，D2 达到了 96.43% 的 Top-1 准确率，而 D3 为 93.94%。 这表明，在针对开发者撰写的注释进行评估时，添加父级/同级上下文以及合成 QA 可能会降低性能。

paragraphs.en: The larger architecture explains these complementary benefits. CodeScribe introduces a structured way of summarizing code at different levels of abstraction through call graph traversal, recursive document synthesis, and chapter-based documentation prompts. The parsing pipeline converts these hierarchical documents into structured records that preserve parent and sibling relationships. These relational signals help the contrastive model learn contextual relationships between methods. D2 excels when queries closely match human-authored documentation, while D3 provides benefits for high-variability or indirectly-specified queries that require broader semantic reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 更大的架构解释了这些互补的优势。 CodeScribe 通过调用图遍历、递归文档合成以及基于章节的文档提示，引入了一种在不同抽象层次上总结代码的结构化方法。 解析流水线将这些层次化的文档转换为保留父级与同级关系的结构化记录。 这些关系信号帮助对比模型学习方法之间的上下文关系。 当查询与人工编写的文档高度匹配时，D2 表现出色；而对于需要更广泛语义推理的高变异性或间接指定的查询，D3 则能提供优势。

paragraphs.en: In practice, the expected query distribution should inform configuration selection: D2 is recommended for applications where queries directly correspond to method documentation (e.g., documentation search), while D3 is better suited for diverse developer queries requiring understanding of broader system context. The practical deployment should measure performance on the target query distribution.

paragraphs.en: Internal Validity: Our evaluation is limited to two repositories, both in the systems programming domain (C and C++). LLM non-determinism and the use of different model versions (Sonnet 4.5 vs 4.0) across pipeline stages may introduce variability. We used Sonnet 4.5 for CodeScribe to ensure high-quality reasoning over large code contexts, and Sonnet 4.0 for simpler generation tasks (missing comments, synthetic questions) to balance quality and cost; this choice may introduce distributional differences in the training data.

paragraphs.en: Additionally, the train/test split is performed at the method level, but parent and sibling context fields in training entries may reference code from held-out test methods. To mitigate this: (1) sibling context includes only method names and brief comments, not full code bodies; (2) the code encoder sees only the target method’s body, not surrounding context; (3) removing cross-references to test methods from training context fields changes Top-1 accuracy by less than 1% on OpenCV, confirming minimal impact.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，训练/测试划分是在方法级别进行的，但训练条目中的父级上下文和同级上下文字段可能引用了被留出的测试方法中的代码。 为缓解这一问题：（1）同级上下文仅包含方法名和简要注释，不包含完整的代码体；（2）代码编码器仅看到目标方法的代码体，而不看到周围的上下文；（3）从训练上下文字段中移除对测试方法的交叉引用后，OpenCV 上的 Top-1 准确率变化不到 1%，证实了其影响极小。

paragraphs.en: Construct Validity: We evaluate the retrieval component in isolation using Top-K and Recall metrics as proxies for “code comprehension.” The final agentic evaluation is conducted using the RAGAS framework, specifically two metrics: FF and AC.
paragraphs.zh: 构念效度：我们使用 Top-K 和 Recall 指标作为「代码理解」的代理指标，单独评估检索组件。最终的智能体评估采用 RAGAS 框架进行，具体使用两个指标：FF 和 AC。

paragraphs.en: Conclusion Validity: The D3 configuration simultaneously adds both parent/sibling context and synthetic QA. Without an intermediate configuration isolating each component, we cannot definitively attribute improvements solely to either source without additional ablation studies. The lack of fine-tuned models for agentic evaluation of code-based question answering may affect the RAGAS evaluation results.
paragraphs.zh: 结论有效性：D3 配置同时添加了父/兄弟上下文和合成问答。 由于缺少用于隔离各组件的中间配置，在没有额外消融实验的情况下，我们无法明确地将改进单独归因于任一来源。 缺少针对基于代码的问题回答的智能体评估的微调模型，可能会影响 RAGAS 评估结果。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we presented Code Comprehensor, a unified retrieval–reasoning framework for understanding large and complex software repositories. The system integrates hierarchical documentation generation via CodeScribe and a dual‑encoder CLIP model to enable precise, scalable code comprehension. Our approach systematically combines call‑graph traversal, structured multi-level documentation, and a rich text–code alignment pipeline to produce a repository‑scale knowledge representation that can be consumed by an agentic orchestration layer. Evaluations on two large repositories, including OpenCV and one proprietary industrial codebase, show complementary benefits across different query distributions: D2 improves retrieval for natural human-authored descriptions (96.43% Top-1 on OpenCV), while D3 provides additional gains for high-variability synthetic query scenarios (80.64% Top-1 on synthetic text → \rightarrow code), with the choice of configuration depending on the expected deployment query distribution. The Code Comprehensor evaluation shows FF scores above 90%, indicating the quality of the MA-generated response.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 Code Comprehensor，一个用于理解大型且复杂软件仓库的统一检索—推理框架。 该系统集成了通过 CodeScribe 实现的分层文档生成以及双编码器 CLIP 模型，从而实现精确、可扩展的代码理解。 我们的方法系统性地结合了调用图遍历、结构化多级文档以及丰富的文本—代码对齐流水线，以生成可供智能体编排层使用的仓库级知识表示。 在两个大型仓库（包括 OpenCV 和一个专有工业代码库）上的评估表明，不同配置在不同查询分布下各有互补优势：D2 提升了对自然人工撰写描述的检索效果（在 OpenCV 上 Top-1 为 96.43%），而 D3 在高变化性的合成查询场景中带来额外收益（在合成文本 → 代码上 Top-1 为 80.64%），具体配置的选择取决于预期的部署查询分布。 Code Comprehensor 的评估显示 FF 分数高于 90%，表明 MA 生成的响应具有良好的质量。

paragraphs.en: Our experimental results are for one C (proprietary) repository and one C++ repository (OpenCV), both in the systems programming domain. paragraphs.en: Future work will expand multimodal capabilities by integrating structural graphs, sequence diagrams, and visual artifacts. This could better capture relationships and control flows that are difficult to express in text, improving retrieval relevance. Additionally, using the CodeGraph as an extra modality would allow the retrieval to be guided by the proximity of nodes in the graph and not just semantic retrieval. Such a process would help improve the answer correctness of the master agent because relevant methods would be retrieved by the CodeGraph agent. Also, synthetic question generation can be refined through improved prompting, richer intent modeling, curriculum-based generation, and adversarial techniques to enhance generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作将通过整合结构图、时序图和可视化产物来扩展多模态能力。 这可以更好地捕捉难以用文本表达的关系和控制流，从而提高检索相关性。 此外，将 CodeGraph 作为一种额外的模态，可以让检索由图中节点的邻近性引导，而不仅仅依赖语义检索。 这样的过程将有助于提高主智能体的答案正确性，因为相关方法会被 CodeGraph 智能体检索到。 此外，还可以通过改进提示、更丰富的意图建模、基于课程式的生成以及对抗性技术来完善合成问题的生成，以增强泛化能力。
